model.name: 3-way merge editor shows per-filetype syntax highlighting in all three panes
model.description: The 3-way merge editor shows correct per-filetype SYNTAX HIGHLIGHTING in all three panes (Local/Result/Repository), driven by the file's language, COEXISTING with the diff/merge change-coloring (R30.35 add/delete/modify/conflict) + the continuous spline (R30.34) - neither overrides the other. Language derives from the file's path/extension (otmux=bash, .cs=C#, .ts=typescript). Architect derives the impl approach + current-state in parallel; impl-AC aligns on confirm. crossRef R30.34 (spline) + R30.35 (change-coloring).
model.tronQuote: > TRON (v0.7.63): the 3-way merge editors must show correct per-filetype syntax highlighting in all three panes (Local/Result/Repository), driven by the file language, coexisting with the diff/merge change-coloring + spline.
model.crossRefNote: Syntax highlighting must COEXIST with R30.34 (always-3-columns + spline) and R30.35 (change-block kind-coloring): the Monaco per-language tokenization and the diff decorations render together, neither clobbering the other. New feature -> next-free R30.41.

discoverySource.flaggedBy: Tron (v0.7.63) via robbin-po; architect deriving impl in parallel
discoverySource.note: Per-filetype syntax highlighting across all 3 merge panes. Observable ACs from Tron; impl approach (Monaco model language per extension across the 3 editors) + current-state PENDING architect derive - align impl-AC on confirm.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Opening a known filetype highlights keywords/strings/comments CORRECTLY in ALL THREE panes (Local / Result / Repository), driven by the file language (otmux -> bash, .cs -> C#, .ts -> typescript).
The language is derived from the file path/extension (per-filetype), not a fixed default; each of the 3 editor models is set to that language.

Syntax highlighting COEXISTS with the diff/merge change-block coloring (R30.35 add/delete/modify/conflict) AND the continuous spline (R30.34): all render intact together, neither the tokenizer nor the diff decorations override the other.

applyLanguage derives the Monaco language id from the left.path extension and calls setModelLanguage(model,id) on all 3 editors at the END of loadSide, mutating the SAME model so R30.35 decorations + R30.34 spline persist (architect-confirmed).

GATE (DET-3x + Tron visual): open otmux (bash) / a .cs (C#) / a .ts (typescript) -> all 3 panes highlight keywords/strings/comments AND the change-blocks + spline still render intact; client-facing -> version-bump + atomic deploy (R30.28).

model.implSiteConfirmed: RbDiffEditor.applyLanguage cd0599ab / Impl 5e0e5cd5: language id from left.path ext -> setModelLanguage on all 3 editors at END of loadSide (same model -> decorations+spline persist). Architect-confirmed.
